vocabulary_groups.title: Figure, sketch, and pose language
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for identifying the sketch and figure position.

items.definition_en: A fashion drawing that shows a design idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um desenho de moda.
items.example_sentence_en: This is a fashion sketch.
items.example_sentence_pt: This is a fashion sketch.
items.professional_context_en: Sketch is the main Week 10 word for reading, writing, and speaking.
items.professional_context_pt: Sketch e a palavra principal da Semana 10 para leitura, escrita e fala.

items.definition_en: A fashion figure sketch used to show a design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um croqui de figura.
items.example_sentence_en: Choose one croquis from the gallery.
items.example_sentence_pt: Choose one croquis from the gallery.
items.professional_context_en: Croquis supports sketch language in studio discussion.
items.professional_context_pt: Croquis apoia a linguagem de sketch em conversas de estudio.

items.definition_en: The drawn person in the sketch.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A pessoa no desenho.
items.example_sentence_en: The figure is standing.
items.example_sentence_pt: The figure is standing.
items.professional_context_en: Figure helps students talk about pose and clothing clearly.
items.professional_context_pt: Figure ajuda os alunos a falar com clareza sobre pose e roupa.

items.definition_en: The body position in the sketch.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: How the body stands or moves.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Como o corpo esta ou se move.
items.example_sentence_en: The pose is relaxed.
items.example_sentence_pt: The pose is relaxed.
items.professional_context_en: Pose adds movement and attitude to sketch description.
items.professional_context_pt: Pose acrescenta movimento e atitude a descricao do sketch.

items.definition_en: The figure is shown from the front.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: You see the figure from the front.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Voce ve a figura de frente.
items.example_sentence_en: This is a front view.
items.example_sentence_pt: This is a front view.
items.professional_context_en: Front view supports basic visual orientation.
items.professional_context_pt: Front view apoia a orientacao visual basica.

vocabulary_groups.title: Garments and outfit combinations
vocabulary_groups.description: Garment words for the main clothing pieces in the sketch.

items.definition_en: A one-piece garment for the body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma roupa inteira.
items.example_sentence_en: The figure is wearing a long dress.
items.example_sentence_pt: The figure is wearing a long dress.
items.professional_context_en: Dress is a high-frequency sketch-description word.
items.professional_context_pt: Dress e uma palavra muito frequente de descricao de sketch.

items.definition_en: A short outer garment for the upper body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um casaco curto.
items.example_sentence_en: The figure is wearing a short denim jacket.
items.example_sentence_pt: The figure is wearing a short denim jacket.
items.professional_context_en: Jacket combines silhouette, fabric, and detail language.
items.professional_context_pt: Jacket combina linguagem de silhueta, tecido e detalhe.

items.definition_en: A garment worn on the upper body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A garment for the top body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma roupa para a parte de cima do corpo.
items.example_sentence_en: The figure is wearing a white top.
items.example_sentence_pt: The figure is wearing a white top.
items.professional_context_en: Top is a flexible beginner garment word.
items.professional_context_pt: Top e uma palavra flexivel de roupa inicial.

items.definition_en: A lower-body garment with two legs.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A lower-body garment with two parts.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma roupa da parte de baixo com duas partes.
items.example_sentence_en: The figure is wearing black pants.
items.example_sentence_pt: The figure is wearing black pants.
items.professional_context_en: Pants supports casual and streetwear looks.
items.professional_context_pt: Pants apoia looks casuais e streetwear.

items.definition_en: A garment that hangs from the waist.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma roupa a partir da cintura.
items.example_sentence_en: The figure is wearing a flared skirt.
items.example_sentence_pt: The figure is wearing a flared skirt.
items.professional_context_en: Skirt supports movement and silhouette language.
items.professional_context_pt: Skirt apoia a linguagem de movimento e silhueta.

vocabulary_groups.title: Garment parts and visible details
vocabulary_groups.description: Detail words students need for visible design parts.

items.definition_en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The arm part of the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte da roupa para o braco.
items.example_sentence_en: The jacket has long sleeves.
items.example_sentence_pt: The jacket has long sleeves.
items.professional_context_en: Sleeve is a key visible detail in sketch description.
items.professional_context_pt: Sleeve e um detalhe visivel importante na descricao do sketch.

items.definition_en: The shape around the neck opening of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O formato da abertura do pescoco.
items.example_sentence_en: The dress has a round neckline.
items.example_sentence_pt: The dress has a round neckline.
items.professional_context_en: Neckline is a useful visible detail for sketches.
items.professional_context_pt: Neckline e um detalhe visivel util para sketches.

items.definition_en: A part of a garment used to hold small things.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A garment part for small objects.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma parte da roupa para pequenos objetos.
items.example_sentence_en: The jacket has two pockets.
items.example_sentence_pt: The jacket has two pockets.
items.professional_context_en: Pocket supports image-based detail questions.
items.professional_context_pt: Pocket apoia perguntas de detalhe baseadas em imagem.

items.definition_en: A fastener with two sides that close together.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The closing part you pull up or down.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte de fechar que voce puxa.
items.example_sentence_en: The jacket has a zipper.
items.example_sentence_pt: The jacket has a zipper.
items.professional_context_en: Zipper gives students one clear functional detail.
items.professional_context_pt: Zipper da aos alunos um detalhe funcional claro.

items.definition_en: Small fasteners on a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Small pieces used to close the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Pequenas pecas usadas para fechar a roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The jacket has buttons on the front.
items.example_sentence_pt: The jacket has buttons on the front.
items.professional_context_en: Buttons supports plural detail language.
items.professional_context_pt: Buttons apoia a linguagem de detalhe no plural.

vocabulary_groups.title: Color, silhouette, and line language
vocabulary_groups.description: Words for describing the overall visual look.

items.definition_en: The main colors used in the design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The group of colors in the look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O grupo de cores no look.
items.example_sentence_en: The color palette is soft and cool.
items.example_sentence_pt: The color palette is soft and cool.
items.professional_context_en: Color palette is a key Week 10 phrase.
items.professional_context_pt: Color palette e uma expressao-chave da Semana 10.

items.definition_en: The overall outer shape of the garment or look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The general shape of the clothing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A forma geral da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The silhouette is long and loose.
items.example_sentence_pt: The silhouette is long and loose.
items.professional_context_en: Silhouette is one of the main design words for sketch description.
items.professional_context_pt: Silhouette e uma das principais palavras de design para descrever um sketch.

items.definition_en: Without strong bright color feeling.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Cores basicas suaves.
items.example_sentence_en: The color palette is neutral.
items.example_sentence_pt: The color palette is neutral.
items.professional_context_en: Neutral helps students describe practical looks.
items.professional_context_pt: Neutral ajuda os alunos a descrever looks praticos.

items.definition_en: Strong and clear in color.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Forte e facil de ver.
items.example_sentence_en: The color palette is bright and playful.
items.example_sentence_pt: The color palette is bright and playful.
items.professional_context_en: Bright helps describe stronger color energy.
items.professional_context_pt: Bright ajuda a descrever energia de cor mais forte.

items.definition_en: Gentle in color or visual feeling.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Leve e calma na sensacao visual.
items.example_sentence_en: The color palette is soft.
items.example_sentence_pt: The color palette is soft.
items.professional_context_en: Soft supports color and design feeling.
items.professional_context_pt: Soft apoia cor e sensacao de design.

items.definition_en: Not curved, with a direct simple line.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Com um formato de linha direta.
items.example_sentence_en: The silhouette is straight and casual.
items.example_sentence_pt: The silhouette is straight and casual.
items.professional_context_en: Straight helps describe simple silhouette choices.
items.professional_context_pt: Straight ajuda a descrever escolhas simples de silhueta.

vocabulary_groups.title: Fabric, texture, and design-comment phrases
vocabulary_groups.description: Words for fabric choice and short design comments.

items.definition_en: A common soft natural fabric.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um tecido comum e macio.
items.example_sentence_en: I imagine this garment in cotton.
items.example_sentence_pt: I imagine this garment in cotton.
items.professional_context_en: Cotton gives students a familiar fabric option.
items.professional_context_pt: Cotton da aos alunos uma opcao familiar de tecido.

items.definition_en: A strong fabric often used for jeans and jackets.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um tecido forte usado em jeans e jaquetas.
items.example_sentence_en: I imagine the jacket in denim.
items.example_sentence_pt: I imagine the jacket in denim.
items.professional_context_en: Denim is one of the clearest Week 10 fabric choices.
items.professional_context_pt: Denim e uma das escolhas de tecido mais claras da Semana 10.

items.definition_en: Not heavy.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Leve e facil de mover.
items.example_sentence_en: The fabric looks lightweight and flowy.
items.example_sentence_pt: The fabric looks lightweight and flowy.
items.professional_context_en: Lightweight connects fabric feel to movement.
items.professional_context_pt: Lightweight conecta a sensacao do tecido ao movimento.

items.definition_en: With a firm shape.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Com forma firme e clara.
items.example_sentence_en: I imagine the jacket in structured denim.
items.example_sentence_pt: I imagine the jacket in structured denim.
items.professional_context_en: Structured links fabric choice to silhouette and function.
items.professional_context_pt: Structured liga escolha de tecido a silhueta e funcao.

items.definition_en: Moving softly and easily.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Moving in a soft free way.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Movendo-se de forma suave e livre.
items.example_sentence_en: The fabric looks flowy.
items.example_sentence_pt: The fabric looks flowy.
items.professional_context_en: Flowy supports movement description in dresses and softer looks.
items.professional_context_pt: Flowy apoia a descricao de movimento em vestidos e looks suaves.

items.definition_en: The most important visible design point.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O detalhe visivel mais importante.
items.example_sentence_en: The main feature is the wide sleeve.
items.example_sentence_pt: The main feature is the wide sleeve.
items.professional_context_en: Main feature helps students move from description to comment.
items.professional_context_pt: Main feature ajuda os alunos a passar da descricao para o comentario.

items.definition_en: The final general impression of the whole design.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The final feeling of the full look.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A impressao final do look inteiro.
items.example_sentence_en: The overall look is modern and comfortable.
items.example_sentence_pt: The overall look is modern and comfortable.
items.professional_context_en: Overall look is a key closing phrase for Week 10.
items.professional_context_pt: Overall look e uma expressao final importante da Semana 10.

items.definition_en: Easy and pleasant to wear.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Good and easy on the body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Boa e facil no corpo.
items.example_sentence_en: The overall look is comfortable.
items.example_sentence_pt: The overall look is comfortable.
items.professional_context_en: Comfortable adds a practical design comment.
items.professional_context_pt: Comfortable acrescenta um comentario pratico de design.

items.definition_en: Light, fun, and full of energy.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Divertido e vivo na sensacao.
items.example_sentence_en: The color palette is bright and playful.
items.example_sentence_pt: The color palette is bright and playful.
items.professional_context_en: Playful gives students a simple mood word for design comment.
items.professional_context_pt: Playful da aos alunos uma palavra simples de clima para comentario de design.
